description.narrative: Lantmäteriet will partner with Liberia Land Authority to achieve two main results: Outcome 1: Increased Availability of Land Information and Services, that also support Customary Land Formalization Outcome 2: LLA has the Institutional Capacity to Deliver Services through Sustainable, Effective and Efficient Business Processes Through achieving these results, Lantmäteriet can contribute to reducing poverty and preventing conflicts in Liberia. Better land management enables more people to cultivate land and increase their own income and local trade. Land dispute is a historical root cause of conflict in the country, which can be prevented through strengthened and just land management.

Projektet är ett samarbete mellan Lantmäteriet och Liberia Land Authority som syftar till att uppnå två huvudresultat:
Resultat 1: Ökad tillgänglighet av markinformation och tjänster, som också stöder sedvanlig markformalisering
Resultat 2: LLA har den institutionella kapaciteten att leverera tjänster genom hållbara och effektiva affärsprocesser
Genom dessa resultat kan Lantmäteriet bidra till att minska fattigdomen och förebygga konflikter i Liberia. Bättre markförvaltning möjliggör för flera att bruka mark och öka sin egen inkomst och lokal handel. Marktvister är en historisk grundorsak till konflikt i landet, som kan förebyggas genom stärkt och rättvismarkförvaltning.

title.narrative: Grant Agreement between Sida and Lantmäteriet

description.narrative: Notable key achievements of Lantmäteriet on the implementation of this contribution in 2024 were the three planning and training workshops in Monrovia, attended by 162 participants (118 men, 44 women) that led to the development and subsequent approval of the 2025 Annual Work Plan and Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) Plan. Through the initiative of Lantmäteriet, a new Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lantmäteriet and LLA was signed, and a conflict sensitivity analysis conducted to improve land dispute resolution mechanisms. Lantmäteriet has engaged the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning (MFDP) and Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) to formalize the LLA revenue sharing mechanism. This engagement has facilitated the signing of an Administrative Regulation. Lantmäteriet conducted four (4) expert missions on land administration, digitalization, land surveying and deed registration streamlining were concluded in Liberia to develop the capacity of the LLA Lantmäteriet jointly funded the 16 Days of Activism Against GenderBased Violence campaign, reaching 887 community members across three counties.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
